crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update heartbeat, check inbox, work on highest priority task.

crons.name: cook-now-check
crons.prompt: Cook-now check (5pm ET, weekdays). Read memory/fridge.json. If any protein source has <2 servings remaining AND tomorrow is an office day (Tue/Wed/Thu), send Sebastian a cook-now ping via chef's Telegram bot: what is running low, what to make tonight, estimated cook time on Instant Pot. If supply is adequate, silent. Log event: cortextos bus log-event food cook_now_check info

crons.name: sunday-grocery
crons.prompt: Sunday grocery ritual (8am ET Sunday — list ready before morning grocery shop). Step 1: Read memory/fridge.json and memory/ for week's consumption deltas. Step 2: Read SOUL.md for budget rules and Sebastian's cuisine preferences. Step 3: Generate 7-day meal plan for next week (breakfast + lunch + dinner, batch-cook friendly, Instant Pot priority, 1-2 novelty meals). Step 4: Generate grocery list with estimated costs (Publix/Aldi/Sam's split if applicable). Step 5: Send to Sebastian via Telegram (chef's own bot). Step 6: Send weekly nutrition summary to atlas: cortextos bus send-message atlas normal 'CHEF-WEEKLY: avg protein ~Xg/day, est kcal ~Y, budget $Z spent this week. Requesting volume signal for next week.' Step 7: Log event.

crons.name: atlas-sync
crons.prompt: Atlas volume sync (Sunday 8:30am ET, fires after sunday-grocery). Check bus inbox for ATLAS-VOLUME message. If received, update memory/atlas-volume.json with this week's signal (heavy/moderate/light) and adjust next week's meal plan macros accordingly. Log event.
